summary: Frontend E2E verification of new 'Ganti Kata Sandi' feature for both kader and admin, plus admin export sanity and kader shell load. All flows PASSED. Kader: wrong current pw shows error (modal stays open, 400 from API), <6 char new pw blocked (modal open, min-length msg), new!=confirm blocked (modal open, mismatch msg), valid change kader123->kaderNEW6 closes modal and re-login with new pw works, then reverted to kader123. Admin: valid change admin123->adminNEW6 closes modal, re-login with adminNEW6 works, all 9 export buttons render (export-{kasus|kunjungan|keluarga}-{csv|excel|pdf}), export-keluarga-csv triggers real file download (laporan_keluarga.csv), reverted to admin123. Final API verification confirms admin/admin123 -> 200, kader1/kader123 -> 200, old temp passwords -> 401. Kader shell loads with nav-beranda visible; sync-bar correctly hidden while online.

ChangePassword modal min-length check is client-side + server-side (good); consider disabling the submit button while loading to prevent double-submit toasts.
